typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Editorial Future' meets 'Swiss Brutalist'. Use Cabinet Grotesk for all primary section headers and widget titles to give a distinct, modern edge. Satoshi provides ultra-clean readability for complex dashboard data. JetBrains Mono is strictly for timestamps, platform constraints (character counts), labels, and metadata.

colors.palette_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Subdued for Premium Professional Context)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look) for the calendar and dense data views. Use 'Crystal Glass' for floating action bars and sticky headers. Never use pure black without grain/noise.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Rely on 1px borders (border-white/10) to define edges and create depth.
visual_enhancers.ai_states: For AI generating states, use blurred radial gradients (e.g., bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF6B6B]/20 to-[#E2FF3D]/20 blur-3xl) behind the active component. No generic AI sparkles.

layout_and_grids.global_spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. Use gap-6 to gap-8 in main grids.
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Start with grid-cols-1, scale to md:grid-cols-3 or lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6.
layout_and_grids.alignment: Strict left-alignment for all dashboard text and data for scanning efficiency. Center only for zero-state/empty screens.

component_guidelines.cards: Flat background (bg-[#121212]), slightly rounded corners (rounded-xl), 1px subtle border (border-white/10). No drop shadows.
component_guidelines.buttons: Primary: Solid #E2FF3D background, text-[#0A0A0A]. Secondary: bg-white/5, border border-white/10, text-white. Sharp corners or full pill depending on context.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized to match dark theme: bg-[#121212] border-white/10 focus:border-[#E2FF3D] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E2FF3D].
component_guidelines.tabs: Minimalist tabs. No background for the tab list. Active tab gets a subtle 1px bottom border in #E2FF3D and white text.

screens.dashboard: Bento grid layout. Hero widget spanning 2 cols for 'What are we creating today?' AI input. Side widgets for 'Recent Drafts' and 'Next Scheduled'. Multi-platform performance summary at the bottom.
screens.content_studio: Split pane interface. Left: Chat/Command interface for poyo.ai integrations. Right: Dynamic preview area that changes based on content type (Text/Video/Image/Music).
screens.repurpose_tool: Two columns. Source input (URL/Text) on the left. On the right, a masonry grid of generated platform-specific cards (X, LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram).
screens.content_calendar: Dense table/grid view for Month/Week. Distinct visual pills (using brand colors) for different platforms. Drag-and-drop enabled.
screens.composer: Main text area on left with AI assist buttons. Right sidebar showing multi-platform previews styled identically to native apps (e.g., Twitter card layout, IG square).

motion.micro_interactions: Framer Motion for layout transitions (layoutId for moving items to calendar). hover:-translate-y-1 for interactive cards.
motion.ai_generation: Subtle pulsing opacity on borders during generation. Staggered fade-in (delay: 0.1s steps) when content populates.

media_and_assets.icons: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react (for high-end polish). Use Duotone weight.

ai_background_1.description: Dark blue and black fluid art for AI generation backgrounds.

ai_background_2.description: Green and pink abstract art for creative moments.

workspace_mockup.description: Modern minimal workspace image for post previews.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast against #0A0A0A or #121212.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus state (e.g., focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E2FF3D]).

testing_attributes.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='generate-post-button').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties only (opacity, transform, background-color).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css. Let the content flow naturally.
Do not use default generic colors. Stick strictly to the provided dark mode palette.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use proper SVG icons (lucide-react).
Ensure all dropdowns, modals, and sticky headers use solid background or heavy backdrop-blur. NO completely transparent backgrounds.
For JavaScript files (.js/.jsx), use standard React functional components. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, located at /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui and heavily customize their Tailwind classes to match this premium dark theme.
